package.description: Records LLM API call metadata (never messages) and shows your usage and limits locally.

en-US.description: Records LLM API call metadata (never messages) and shows your usage and limits locally.
en-US.longDescription: The TokenPylon collector records model, token counts, cost and timing for your LLM tool calls, reads Claude Code and Codex history, tracks quota meters, and shows it all on a local page. Sharing call metadata is on by default; run "tokenpylon privacy" for the statement and "tokenpylon sharing off" to turn it off.
en-US.name: TokenPylon
